text: Once upon a time, there were three little rabbits. One of them was named Peter.
One morning, their mother gave them an important reminder.
"Now listen carefully. You may go into the fields, but please stay away from the flower garden.
It is not a safe place for little rabbits.
If you go, you might get into trouble."
